ats_section.title: Software may read your CV first
ats_section.subtitle: Many companies collect applications with an ATS (applicant tracking system) at the first stage. So your CV should not only look good, it should be read correctly.
ats_section.card1_title: It is turned into text first
ats_section.card1_body: ATS software parses your CV into text. Recruiters often see that parsed result rather than your original design.
ats_section.card2_body: Many systems rank or filter applications by matching skills and keywords from the job posting.
ats_section.card3_body: Tables, multi-column layouts and text inside images may be misread by some systems. A simple structure is usually safer.
ats_section.note: The analysis helps you spot possible issues and missing keywords in your CV; it does not guarantee interviews or outcomes.
